title: Esme's Smart Acorn Guess
markdown:
The meadow glowed with twilight colours. A gentle breeze whispered through the grasses. In their cozy shed, Esme and Tumble the goat had a big job: gathering acorns for winter naps. What a wonderful warm brown pile. It looked like a cozy mountain.

“It’s such a big pile, Esme,” Tumble bleated, a tiny worry in his whiskers. “How will we know if it’s enough for all our quiet winter days?”

Esme blinked. Counting so many acorns felt like a very big task.

They sat a moment, not rushing. The last light made each shell a small brown lantern. A moth bumped the window and thought better of it. Esme remembered Mrs Quinn: You don’t need to count every single little thing to know if you have enough. A very smart guess can tell you a wonderful story.

A smart guess. Esme scooped a small handful. Smooth in her palm. “One, two… ten.” Ten acorns in this handful. She looked at the mountain. Many, many handfuls. If each was about ten, it must be a very big number.

Tumble watched. Esme scooped another. “This one has… eleven.” Some tens, some elevens. A generous mountain.

“It’s called estimating,” she told him, gentle wonder. “A very, very smart guess. We know it’s a lot.”

Tumble nudged the pile. A contented rumble. “It feels like enough. Warmth and yummy munching.”

A soft knock. Mrs Quinn, eyes twinkling like faraway stars. “Just checking on my little helpers. How are our acorn stores?”

Esme beamed. “We’re estimating. Lots and lots.”

Quinn’s gaze swept the pile. “A wonderful way to know things when counting every one would take all day. A clever guess.” She did not add a lullaby-lecture. The mountain said plenty.

The last soft light painted the world. Esme and Tumble snuggled. The shed held a warm promise. Esme smiled at her clever guess. “I wonder what else we could estimate.” Soon, lulled by the quiet satisfaction of knowing they had plenty, they drifted toward slumber, the acorns ticking softly as they settled, too many to count and enough not to need to.
characters: Esme (a star gazer), Tumble (a goat), Quinn (a neighbor)
author: StoryGen Community
